-88.16110,41.54750.name: Reproductive Health Specialists, Ltd.
-88.16110,41.54750.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-85.10053,41.08972.desc: A clinic mapped in OpenStreetMap as offering fertility treatment. Operated by Planned Parenthood. 104.13889,30.63118.name: C Ray Therapeutics (Chengdu) Co., Ltd.
104.13889,30.63118.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

18.02300,59.34900.name: High Containment Laboratory
18.02300,59.34900.state: Public Health Agency of Sweden, SE-17182 Solna, Sweden, Sweden
18.02300,59.34900.company: Folkhälsmyndigheten (FOHM), Public Health Agency of Sweden
18.02300,59.34900.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Folkhälsmyndigheten (FOHM), Public Health Agency of Sweden. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 136 SqM. Operational or announced: 2001. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

144.88000,-37.79000.name: Nufarm
144.88000,-37.79000.desc: An Australian agrochemical company, and one of the largest generic producers of off-patent herbicides including glyphosate. Once a patent lapses the chemistry does not disappear — it gets cheaper, and generic manufacturers expand the market the original patent holder created. The traits engineered to survive these herbicides remain valuable long after the herbicide itself stops being anyone’s exclusive property.

144.88000,-37.79000.name: Nuseed / Nufarm omega-3 canola
144.88000,-37.79000.desc: Canola engineered to produce long-chain omega-3 oils previously obtained from fish, grown in Australia, the United States and Canada. It substitutes a crop for a wild-capture fishery, which is one of the few cases on this map where an engineered organism reduces pressure on a wild population rather than adding to it.

-93.71500,41.61400.name: Corteva — hybrid wheat programme
-93.71500,41.61400.desc: Hybrid wheat has been attempted for decades because hybrids yield more and cannot be saved — the seed has to be repurchased annually. The agronomic argument and the commercial one point the same way, which is why it keeps being attempted.
